incident: Phoenix run 33006908257 successfully re-enabled and dispatched the Airlock-admitted SOVARA LiteLLM v2.3 provider gateway, but the convergence evaluator still omitted that workflow from its REQUIRED set and therefore classified the now-correct active workflow as unexpected. The workflow receipt was READBACK_FAILED despite exact individual active-state readback.
root_cause: Duplicated hard-coded workflow truth: Phoenix YAML had been repaired, while phoenix/workflow_freeze_convergence.py and its regression fixture retained the six-workflow predecessor set.
repair: add the provider-admission workflow to the convergence REQUIRED set
make an active provider gateway explicitly non-unexpected
fail convergence when the provider gateway is disabled
bind the Phoenix YAML required-active contract to focused regression tests
learning: Whenever an execution allowlist changes, every YAML keep-active set, individual readback set, convergence evaluator, test fixture and owner-visible registry must be updated atomically and tested against both active and disabled states.
truth_boundary: This repair corrects workflow-state convergence only. It does not repair Google WIF or establish any provider, model, deployment, serving or FULLY_ESTABLISHED claim.
